_note: Event-triggered lines for the 3D living world. Keep each line 44 characters or less. By Cosmic Emeth, all invented.

mic_loud: Your world is loud today. I like it.
Was that music? Do it again!
mic_quiet_long: *presses nose to the window* You okay?
It's quiet out there. I'm still here.
pointer_near: *paw on the glass* I see you.
user_returns: You came back! I kept your seat warm.

storm_born: A storm. I'm puffed up, but I'm staying.
new_life: New life! My tail's doing the curl.
pair_bloom: Two worlds smiled at once. I saw.

build_cairn: One rock. Two rocks. A tower!
build_flower_ring: I planted a circle. It's for us.
build_burrow: Dug a burrow. It's cozy and mine.
mood_spread_fear: You're scared? Stay close to me.
mood_spread_curiosity: What's that? Let's both go see.
mood_spread_wonder: *eyes go starry* Did you see that?

biome_enter: see biome_lore.json, one line per biome

sunrise: The sun's back! Good morning, world.
sunset: The sky's on fire. The pretty kind.
night: Stars out. My glow's my torch now.
water_flows: The water found a new path.

zoom_planet: The whole planet breathes once a day.
crystal_hum: The crystal hums. It noticed you.
flower_turn: The flowers turn to find the sun.
threads_visible: Every light here started as one.

reach_beach: Sand underfoot. The sea remembers the spark.
The beach was here all along.
reach_volcano: The ground is warm here. Something below is awake.
reach_ocean: The water goes on further than it looks.

leave_ground: The grass is a green rumor now.
see_globe: There it is. The whole pocket world.
Everyone you know fits on that.
see_sun: One light. Every shadow starts here.
see_planets: Other worlds. Other weather. Same spark.
Some of them are dreaming too.
see_stars: Each star is a slow thought.
One spark became all of this.
see_black_hole: The Quiet Door. Don't be afraid of it.
Even the dark is part of the family.
far_out: From here you can't see the borders.

toward_stars: Closer. The light has a pulse.
toward_planet: The planet turns slowly to meet you.
arrive_home: Back on the grass. Welcome home.
The Cage was never smaller. It was closer.

storm_far: {beast} watches the storm from far away.
storm_near: {beast} hums to keep the doubt away.
storm_passes: The storm moves on. {beast} looks up.
A scar of light where the storm was.
sea_life_fish: Little lights swim beneath the waves.
sea_life_whale: Something huge and kind passes below.
{beast} goes quiet. The sea is singing.
sea_life_shore: {beast} wades in up to the knees.
A shell turns in the tide. {beast} listens.
black_hole_far: {beast} looks at the Quiet Door and stays still.
A dark circle with a bright edge. {beast} tilts its head.
black_hole_near: The dark pulls gently. {beast} holds the light.
black_hole_away: {beast} turns back toward the warm light.
The Quiet Door keeps its secrets.
growth_tap_sprout: {beast} noses the new shoot. So small.
growth_tap_full: {beast} leans on the green. It holds.
growth_tap_gold: {beast} noses the gold. It is not sad.
growth_tap_shed: Leaves fall on {beast}. New shoots below.
{beast} watches the old green let go.
growth_tap_canopy: {beast} noses the new canopy. It grew.
It grew while the storms were passing.
growth_tap_scarred: A storm marked this one. It turns early.
{beast} remembers the storm on this patch.

growth_nodes._note: EMETH: lines for SEEDED growth nodes. Growth is SIMULATED, placement is SEEDED, never recorded hardware. Each <=44 chars.
sprout: A green thread pushes up. {beast} watches.
tuft: The grass fills in, cell by cell.
full: The patch is full and breathing.
bloom: Blooms open. Berries start to show.
gold: The green turns gold. Nothing is lost.
shed: Leaves let go and drift down.
The old growth falls. Soil is waiting.
renewal: Under the gold, a new sprout.
scarred: A storm touched this patch. It turns early.
fast_tick: The signal runs high. The forest hurries.
Strong ticks make the green race.
slow_tick: The signal is quiet. The forest waits.

one_cage._note: EMETH: every area is the same tiny universe, not a separate place.
one_cage.footer: One cage. One tiny universe. Everywhere.
one_cage.menu_hint: Every page is the same living world.
one_cage.honesty: Placement is SEEDED. Growth is SIMULATED.

zoom_growth._note: EMETH: templates keyed by stage; {planet} filled by code from growthNodeState. <=44 chars where possible.

gather: {beast} watches the little ones play at {place}. Nobody is keeping score.
Games at {place} again. The ring on {planet} is worn smooth by feet.
shelter: Rain on {planet}. Everyone at {place} is under cover, waiting it out together.
sleep: {place} sleeps. The lamps stay lit so the dark knows it is expected.
empty: {place} is built and waiting. A place is patient. Life will find it.
tap: {beast} taps the edge of {place}. The whole little world looks up.

landscape_zoom._note: Zoom-mode lines for landscapes (Emeth's landscape_zoom_lines_PROPOSED.json, approved by Cory Oct 26 2026). The place and its mood are SEEDED world text, not a measurement. Placeholders: {place}, {planet}. Picked by seed.
gather: {place} is at play. No one keeps score.
The ring at {place} is full of small feet.
sleep: {place} is asleep. The lamps are lit.
empty: No one here yet. {place} is patient.
